how_to_score.title: How does the scoring system work?
how_to_score.summary: Compete with Mapilio contributors from all over the world and win great prizes!
how_to_score.paragraph:
Mapilio Awarding System

It is possible to collect points from shootings in Mapilio and win prizes

Scoring system

A global leaderboard will allow you to compare your local contributions with other participants. The leaderboard will have a scoring system that will take into account multiple elements of contribution. Here are the variables that make up the score:

● Unique kilometres (UKM):

this is the total distance of sequences contributed in areas with no previous coverage. For example, if you drove for 10 km and 7 km of it did not have existing imagery, your UKM for that drive would be 7 km.

● Images:

the total number of images the contributor has uploaded during the challenge

● Participants:

this is the number of people participating in your local challenge. The idea is to encourage and reward collaboration. The formula to calculate the score is as follows: Score = (total UKM contributed + (images/1000)) * (1 + (count of participants/10))

Remember;

To be eligible for a prize, you must reach a minimum score of 100. In order to get scores from your shots, the location must be clear, imagery must be taken in bright enough light, and they must not have been taken in weather conditions such as fog, rain or other weather conditions that distort the image. Now you can start capture, collect points and compete for the lead.

award.summary: Are you ready to collect reward with <0>Mapilio 🌍🏆</0>
award.title: Earn new gifts as you reach more kilometers
award.description: Are you ready for a challenge? The 3 contestant who score the most points between <date>01.03.2023</date> and <date>31.05.2023</date> will win great prizes.
award.content:
<title>It`s very simple to attend</title>

Capture as much as you can, collect more points than other competitors get your reward. There are few things when you are capturing;

<bold>● Focus The Road</bold> Set the focus as the path by touching the screen.

<bold>● Clean Images</bold> Make sure that the vehicle hood and other objects are not visible in the image.

<bold>● Camera Direction</bold> Adjust the position of the camera to record the image parallel to the ground.

<bold>● Situations That Shouldn't Shoot</bold> Shooting should not be done in dark, rainy, snowy weather, when the image is blurred.

<bold>● Exact Location</bold> Location Services of your device must be on and precise.
